pipeline.sat: EqGPT only; Hard has no grammar/physical/control-ID generation mask
pipeline.candidate_order: serial generation then immediate shared evaluation
pipeline.randomness: seed + cycle*attempts + attempt; independent candidate streams
pipeline.length: maximum NEW predictions after BOS, including EOS
pipeline.terminal: EOS or token_limit; exact representation must be parseable
pipeline.cleanup: shared author delete_duplicate, including its documented operator-blind behavior
pipeline.failures: shared status filtering; non-evaluated candidates cannot enter Top10
pipeline.selection: shared float32 reward dedup, same merge and available-candidate policy
pipeline.continuation: same optimizer/model binding and cleaned structure inputs
